message.gugugaga.journal.gaze: I · THE GAZE — It faced you before you knew where to look.
message.gugugaga.journal.footsteps: II · THE FOOTSTEPS — The soft steps stopped when you turned.
message.gugugaga.journal.retreat: III · THE RETREAT — It withdrew. There were no footprints.
message.gugugaga.journal.ending: Final note: The footsteps began before you turned around.
message.gugugaga.journal.off: Witness journal paused. Your existing clues remain private.
message.gugugaga.journal.clear: Your witness journal was cleared. Recording preference kept.
